rationale: The plan matches the reference on the core decision: it refuses DESeq2/edgeR/voom on TPM, fits limma lmFit+eBayes with trend=TRUE on log2(TPM+1), sets control as reference with an explicit lesional-control contrast, and uses BH at 0.05 via topTable with no size factors or TMM. QC (PCA/MDS, distance heatmap, detected-gene counts, outlier flagging policy) and the filter (TPM>=1 in at least 6 samples, the smaller group) follow the reference closely. It notes the TPM-only limitation but does not explicitly request the raw counts or quantification directories, a small omission. Enrichment was not asked but is specified well (full ranked list on moderated t, named collections, 15-500 window, BH, collapse), though the Reactome version is only 'current'.
